Felix could not teach me more. Few options; wandering toward the trees.
Fire is low; adding wood and clearing my pack.
Fed the fire. Heading for fruit trees to stock the household.
Picked 4 fruit. Eating now; will fill up again and take food home.
Ate, hunger 75. Topping up fruit for the household.
Pack full of fruit and berries. Heading home with the household's supper.
Put 4 fruit in the store, it looks bare. More berries nearby.
Dusk. Picked clean one bush; taking 5 berries home.
Dusk, dark. Stored 2 berries, kept 3. No sign of Ivo or the children; sleeping at home.
Woke at midnight, cold. Family asleep nearby. Thirst low; going to the water.
Drank my fill. Cold and dark; heading home.
Home at 3am. Everyone is stirring. Asking Pia for a stone.
4am. Pia promised a stone. Going to pick berries before dawn.
Dawn. Pia's stone arrived. Hunger 91. Time to make the rod.
Made the rod. Fetching water first, fishing after.
Fetched 3 water. A wolf stands near Orla; bringing water to Kai while I watch.
Water to Kai failed: his pack was full. Going to fish.
Caught 2 fish. Drinking before the long walk home.

journal.text: Dawn of day 2. Full pack, no obvious task; going home to find my family.
Home is 3 tiles away and my whole family is in sight. Went to learn from Felix.
Felix could not teach me more. Few options; wandering toward the trees.
Fire is low; adding wood and clearing my pack.
Fed the fire. Heading for fruit trees to stock the household.
Picked 4 fruit. Eating now; will fill up again and take food home.
Ate, hunger 75. Topping up fruit for the household.
Pack full of fruit and berries. Heading home with the household's supper.
Put 4 fruit in the store, it looks bare. More berries nearby.
Dusk. Picked clean one bush; taking 5 berries home.
Dusk, dark. Stored 2 berries, kept 3. No sign of Ivo or the children; sleeping at home.
Woke at midnight, cold. Family asleep nearby. Thirst low; going to the water.
Drank my fill. Cold and dark; heading home.
Home at 3am. Everyone is stirring. Asking Pia for a stone.
4am. Pia promised a stone. Going to pick berries before dawn.
Dawn. Pia's stone arrived. Hunger 91. Time to make the rod.
Made the rod. Fetching water first, fishing after.
Fetched 3 water. A wolf stands near Orla; bringing water to Kai while I watch.
Water to Kai failed: his pack was full. Going to fish.
Caught 2 fish. Drinking before the long walk home.
Drank. Heading home with fish, berries and water.
Back home area at 1pm. Putting fish and berries in the store.
Deposited 2 fish and a berry. A wolf appears NW; warning Kai.

Fire is low; adding wood and clearing my pack.

Caught 2 fish. Drinking before the long walk home.
Drank. Heading home with fish, berries and water.
Back home area at 1pm. Putting fish and berries in the store.
Deposited 2 fish and a berry. A wolf appears NW; warning Kai.

Orla was not where I expected; two wolves nearby. Heading toward Edda's fire.
Back at the fire at dusk. Drinking at the new well before sleep.
Well dry. Family near. Sleeping at home in the rain.
Woke at 1am in rain, 1C. 'We are expecting a child.' Giving Kai berries and water.
Gave Kai 2 berries and water. Cold; going to the fire.
5am by the fire. Ivo gave me a fish. Drinking from my skin.
Dawn, dark still. Drank my skin full. Going east for berries.

Home at 7:30, hunger 24. Deposited a fish; eating from the store.

journal.text: Dawn of day 2. Full pack, no obvious task; going home to find my family.
Home is 3 tiles away and my whole family is in sight. Went to learn from Felix.
Felix could not teach me more. Few options; wandering toward the trees.
Fire is low; adding wood and clearing my pack.
Fed the fire. Heading for fruit trees to stock the household.
Picked 4 fruit. Eating now; will fill up again and take food home.
Ate, hunger 75. Topping up fruit for the household.
Pack full of fruit and berries. Heading home with the household's supper.
Put 4 fruit in the store, it looks bare. More berries nearby.
Dusk. Picked clean one bush; taking 5 berries home.
Dusk, dark. Stored 2 berries, kept 3. No sign of Ivo or the children; sleeping at home.
Woke at midnight, cold. Family asleep nearby. Thirst low; going to the water.
Drank my fill. Cold and dark; heading home.
Home at 3am. Everyone is stirring. Asking Pia for a stone.
4am. Pia promised a stone. Going to pick berries before dawn.
Dawn. Pia's stone arrived. Hunger 91. Time to make the rod.
Made the rod. Fetching water first, fishing after.
Fetched 3 water. A wolf stands near Orla; bringing water to Kai while I watch.
Water to Kai failed: his pack was full. Going to fish.
Caught 2 fish. Drinking before the long walk home.
Drank. Heading home with fish, berries and water.
Back home area at 1pm. Putting fish and berries in the store.
Deposited 2 fish and a berry. A wolf appears NW; warning Kai.
Warned Kai. A new well stands by home. Going to look for Orla with water.
Orla was not where I expected; two wolves nearby. Heading toward Edda's fire.
Back at the fire at dusk. Drinking at the new well before sleep.
Well dry. Family near. Sleeping at home in the rain.
Woke at 1am in rain, 1C. 'We are expecting a child.' Giving Kai berries and water.
Gave Kai 2 berries and water. Cold; going to the fire.
5am by the fire. Ivo gave me a fish. Drinking from my skin.
Dawn, dark still. Drank my skin full. Going east for berries.
Picked 3 berries; still hungry because I hold it for the kids. Wolves near Orla; heading home.
Home at 7:30, hunger 24. Deposited a fish; eating from the store.
Ate; hunger 100. The store is nearly bare again; restocking.
Full and rested. Off NW for wild grain.

journal.text: Dawn of day 2. Full pack, no obvious task; going home to find my family.
Home is 3 tiles away and my whole family is in sight. Went to learn from Felix.
Felix could not teach me more. Few options; wandering toward the trees.
Fire is low; adding wood and clearing my pack.
Fed the fire. Heading for fruit trees to stock the household.
Picked 4 fruit. Eating now; will fill up again and take food home.
Ate, hunger 75. Topping up fruit for the household.
Pack full of fruit and berries. Heading home with the household's supper.
Put 4 fruit in the store, it looks bare. More berries nearby.
Dusk. Picked clean one bush; taking 5 berries home.
Dusk, dark. Stored 2 berries, kept 3. No sign of Ivo or the children; sleeping at home.
Woke at midnight, cold. Family asleep nearby. Thirst low; going to the water.
Drank my fill. Cold and dark; heading home.
Home at 3am. Everyone is stirring. Asking Pia for a stone.
4am. Pia promised a stone. Going to pick berries before dawn.
Dawn. Pia's stone arrived. Hunger 91. Time to make the rod.
Made the rod. Fetching water first, fishing after.
Fetched 3 water. A wolf stands near Orla; bringing water to Kai while I watch.
Water to Kai failed: his pack was full. Going to fish.
Caught 2 fish. Drinking before the long walk home.
Drank. Heading home with fish, berries and water.
Back home area at 1pm. Putting fish and berries in the store.
Deposited 2 fish and a berry. A wolf appears NW; warning Kai.
Warned Kai. A new well stands by home. Going to look for Orla with water.
Orla was not where I expected; two wolves nearby. Heading toward Edda's fire.
Back at the fire at dusk. Drinking at the new well before sleep.
Well dry. Family near. Sleeping at home in the rain.
Woke at 1am in rain, 1C. 'We are expecting a child.' Giving Kai berries and water.
Gave Kai 2 berries and water. Cold; going to the fire.
5am by the fire. Ivo gave me a fish. Drinking from my skin.
Dawn, dark still. Drank my skin full. Going east for berries.
Picked 3 berries; still hungry because I hold it for the kids. Wolves near Orla; heading home.
Home at 7:30, hunger 24. Deposited a fish; eating from the store.
Ate; hunger 100. The store is nearly bare again; restocking.
Full and rested. Off NW for wild grain.
Reached the west grove; rich. Filling my pack.
Five grain from the west grove. Heading home with it before dark.

journal.text: Dawn of day 2. Full pack, no obvious task; going home to find my family.
Home is 3 tiles away and my whole family is in sight. Went to learn from Felix.
Felix could not teach me more. Few options; wandering toward the trees.
Fire is low; adding wood and clearing my pack.
Fed the fire. Heading for fruit trees to stock the household.
Picked 4 fruit. Eating now; will fill up again and take food home.
Ate, hunger 75. Topping up fruit for the household.
Pack full of fruit and berries. Heading home with the household's supper.
Put 4 fruit in the store, it looks bare. More berries nearby.
Dusk. Picked clean one bush; taking 5 berries home.
Dusk, dark. Stored 2 berries, kept 3. No sign of Ivo or the children; sleeping at home.
Woke at midnight, cold. Family asleep nearby. Thirst low; going to the water.
Drank my fill. Cold and dark; heading home.
Home at 3am. Everyone is stirring. Asking Pia for a stone.
4am. Pia promised a stone. Going to pick berries before dawn.
Dawn. Pia's stone arrived. Hunger 91. Time to make the rod.
Made the rod. Fetching water first, fishing after.

Water to Kai failed: his pack was full. Going to fish.
Caught 2 fish. Drinking before the long walk home.
Drank. Heading home with fish, berries and water.
Back home area at 1pm. Putting fish and berries in the store.
Deposited 2 fish and a berry. A wolf appears NW; warning Kai.
Warned Kai. A new well stands by home. Going to look for Orla with water.
Orla was not where I expected; two wolves nearby. Heading toward Edda's fire.
Back at the fire at dusk. Drinking at the new well before sleep.
Well dry. Family near. Sleeping at home in the rain.
Woke at 1am in rain, 1C. 'We are expecting a child.' Giving Kai berries and water.
Gave Kai 2 berries and water. Cold; going to the fire.
5am by the fire. Ivo gave me a fish. Drinking from my skin.
Dawn, dark still. Drank my skin full. Going east for berries.
Picked 3 berries; still hungry because I hold it for the kids. Wolves near Orla; heading home.
Home at 7:30, hunger 24. Deposited a fish; eating from the store.
Ate; hunger 100. The store is nearly bare again; restocking.
Full and rested. Off NW for wild grain.
Reached the west grove; rich. Filling my pack.
Five grain from the west grove. Heading home with it before dark.
Put 5 grain in the store. Fire nearly out; going for wood.
Got 3 wood. Fire is fine. Thirsty at dusk; going to the well.

goals.text: Keep Kai (4) and Orla (2) fed, warm and safe; a new child is expected.
Stay close to Ivo and the home lean-to (1006); store for a lean season (2 more units wanted).
Fish with my rod and carry more with my new basket.

intentions.text: Sleep at 1006. Tomorrow: drink, fish at 984/985 or forage the west grove with the basket (capacity 18), fetch 3 stone for our hut (site 3665).
Tell Ivo about the child.

inferences.text: The basket raised my carrying capacity from 12 to 18.
Store 1006 holds grain 9, berries 1: enough for a few meals for the family.

uncertainties.text: Does Ivo know about the child?
Will the wolves return tomorrow?

journal.text: Home is 3 tiles away and my whole family is in sight. Went to learn from Felix.
Felix could not teach me more. Few options; wandering toward the trees.
Fire is low; adding wood and clearing my pack.
Fed the fire. Heading for fruit trees to stock the household.
Picked 4 fruit. Eating now; will fill up again and take food home.
Ate, hunger 75. Topping up fruit for the household.
Pack full of fruit and berries. Heading home with the household's supper.
Put 4 fruit in the store, it looks bare. More berries nearby.
Dusk. Picked clean one bush; taking 5 berries home.
Dusk, dark. Stored 2 berries, kept 3. No sign of Ivo or the children; sleeping at home.
Woke at midnight, cold. Family asleep nearby. Thirst low; going to the water.
Drank my fill. Cold and dark; heading home.
Home at 3am. Everyone is stirring. Asking Pia for a stone.
4am. Pia promised a stone. Going to pick berries before dawn.
Dawn. Pia's stone arrived. Hunger 91. Time to make the rod.
Made the rod. Fetching water first, fishing after.
Fetched 3 water. A wolf stands near Orla; bringing water to Kai while I watch.
Water to Kai failed: his pack was full. Going to fish.
Caught 2 fish. Drinking before the long walk home.
Drank. Heading home with fish, berries and water.
Back home area at 1pm. Putting fish and berries in the store.
Deposited 2 fish and a berry. A wolf appears NW; warning Kai.
Warned Kai. A new well stands by home. Going to look for Orla with water.
Orla was not where I expected; two wolves nearby. Heading toward Edda's fire.
Back at the fire at dusk. Drinking at the new well before sleep.
Well dry. Family near. Sleeping at home in the rain.
Woke at 1am in rain, 1C. 'We are expecting a child.' Giving Kai berries and water.
Gave Kai 2 berries and water. Cold; going to the fire.
5am by the fire. Ivo gave me a fish. Drinking from my skin.
Dawn, dark still. Drank my skin full. Going east for berries.
Picked 3 berries; still hungry because I hold it for the kids. Wolves near Orla; heading home.
Home at 7:30, hunger 24. Deposited a fish; eating from the store.
Ate; hunger 100. The store is nearly bare again; restocking.
Full and rested. Off NW for wild grain.
Reached the west grove; rich. Filling my pack.
Five grain from the west grove. Heading home with it before dark.
Put 5 grain in the store. Fire nearly out; going for wood.
Got 3 wood. Fire is fine. Thirsty at dusk; going to the well.
Drank at the well; thirst full. Making a basket at home.
Made a basket (capacity 18). Sleeping at home on day 4 night.

journal.text: Dusk, dark. Stored 2 berries, kept 3. No sign of Ivo or the children; sleeping at home.
Woke at midnight, cold. Family asleep nearby. Thirst low; going to the water.
Drank my fill. Cold and dark; heading home.
Home at 3am. Everyone is stirring. Asking Pia for a stone.
4am. Pia promised a stone. Going to pick berries before dawn.
Dawn. Pia's stone arrived. Hunger 91. Time to make the rod.
Made the rod. Fetching water first, fishing after.
Fetched 3 water. A wolf stands near Orla; bringing water to Kai while I watch.
Water to Kai failed: his pack was full. Going to fish.
Caught 2 fish. Drinking before the long walk home.
Drank. Heading home with fish, berries and water.
Back home area at 1pm. Putting fish and berries in the store.
Deposited 2 fish and a berry. A wolf appears NW; warning Kai.
Warned Kai. A new well stands by home. Going to look for Orla with water.
Orla was not where I expected; two wolves nearby. Heading toward Edda's fire.
Back at the fire at dusk. Drinking at the new well before sleep.
Well dry. Family near. Sleeping at home in the rain.
Woke at 1am in rain, 1C. 'We are expecting a child.' Giving Kai berries and water.
Gave Kai 2 berries and water. Cold; going to the fire.
5am by the fire. Ivo gave me a fish. Drinking from my skin.
Dawn, dark still. Drank my skin full. Going east for berries.
Picked 3 berries; still hungry because I hold it for the kids. Wolves near Orla; heading home.
Home at 7:30, hunger 24. Deposited a fish; eating from the store.
Ate; hunger 100. The store is nearly bare again; restocking.
Full and rested. Off NW for wild grain.
Reached the west grove; rich. Filling my pack.
Five grain from the west grove. Heading home with it before dark.
Put 5 grain in the store. Fire nearly out; going for wood.
Got 3 wood. Fire is fine. Thirsty at dusk; going to the well.
Drank at the well; thirst full. Making a basket at home.
Made a basket (capacity 18). Sleeping at home on day 4 night.
Woke at 1am, 1C, rain. Staying with the children under our roof.
Storm at dawn, 0C. Eating, then to the fire.
Ate, hunger 100; warmth 23 still. Drawing water for Kai.
Storm, 2C. Whole village at the fire. Bringing Orla berries and water.
Gave Orla berries and water. Now warming at the fire with all of them.
Warm again (55). New plan: our hut needs 3 stone. Offering water to Felix.
Felix could not take water. Asking Dax for stone.
Dax refused stone. Thirst 43; drinking from my skin.
Day 5 forenoon, storm. Thirst full, hunger 86. Setting off to quarry stone for our hut.

journal.text: Drank my fill. Cold and dark; heading home.
Home at 3am. Everyone is stirring. Asking Pia for a stone.
4am. Pia promised a stone. Going to pick berries before dawn.
Dawn. Pia's stone arrived. Hunger 91. Time to make the rod.
Made the rod. Fetching water first, fishing after.
Fetched 3 water. A wolf stands near Orla; bringing water to Kai while I watch.
Water to Kai failed: his pack was full. Going to fish.
Caught 2 fish. Drinking before the long walk home.
Drank. Heading home with fish, berries and water.
Back home area at 1pm. Putting fish and berries in the store.
Deposited 2 fish and a berry. A wolf appears NW; warning Kai.
Warned Kai. A new well stands by home. Going to look for Orla with water.
Orla was not where I expected; two wolves nearby. Heading toward Edda's fire.
Back at the fire at dusk. Drinking at the new well before sleep.
Well dry. Family near. Sleeping at home in the rain.
Woke at 1am in rain, 1C. 'We are expecting a child.' Giving Kai berries and water.
Gave Kai 2 berries and water. Cold; going to the fire.
5am by the fire. Ivo gave me a fish. Drinking from my skin.
Dawn, dark still. Drank my skin full. Going east for berries.
Picked 3 berries; still hungry because I hold it for the kids. Wolves near Orla; heading home.
Home at 7:30, hunger 24. Deposited a fish; eating from the store.
Ate; hunger 100. The store is nearly bare again; restocking.
Full and rested. Off NW for wild grain.
Reached the west grove; rich. Filling my pack.
Five grain from the west grove. Heading home with it before dark.
Put 5 grain in the store. Fire nearly out; going for wood.
Got 3 wood. Fire is fine. Thirsty at dusk; going to the well.
Drank at the well; thirst full. Making a basket at home.
Made a basket (capacity 18). Sleeping at home on day 4 night.
Woke at 1am, 1C, rain. Staying with the children under our roof.
Storm at dawn, 0C. Eating, then to the fire.
Ate, hunger 100; warmth 23 still. Drawing water for Kai.
Storm, 2C. Whole village at the fire. Bringing Orla berries and water.
Gave Orla berries and water. Now warming at the fire with all of them.
Warm again (55). New plan: our hut needs 3 stone. Offering water to Felix.
Felix could not take water. Asking Dax for stone.
Dax refused stone. Thirst 43; drinking from my skin.
Day 5 forenoon, storm. Thirst full, hunger 86. Setting off to quarry stone for our hut.
Tick 10090: rock 941 was empty; breaking stone at 947 nearby. Everyone else is at the fire.
Tick 10471: 5 stone in my pack, pack full. Walking it north-east to our hut site.

journal.text: Well dry. Family near. Sleeping at home in the rain.
Woke at 1am in rain, 1C. 'We are expecting a child.' Giving Kai berries and water.
Gave Kai 2 berries and water. Cold; going to the fire.
5am by the fire. Ivo gave me a fish. Drinking from my skin.
Dawn, dark still. Drank my skin full. Going east for berries.
Picked 3 berries; still hungry because I hold it for the kids. Wolves near Orla; heading home.
Home at 7:30, hunger 24. Deposited a fish; eating from the store.
Ate; hunger 100. The store is nearly bare again; restocking.
Full and rested. Off NW for wild grain.
Reached the west grove; rich. Filling my pack.
Five grain from the west grove. Heading home with it before dark.
Put 5 grain in the store. Fire nearly out; going for wood.
Got 3 wood. Fire is fine. Thirsty at dusk; going to the well.
Drank at the well; thirst full. Making a basket at home.
Made a basket (capacity 18). Sleeping at home on day 4 night.
Woke at 1am, 1C, rain. Staying with the children under our roof.
Storm at dawn, 0C. Eating, then to the fire.
Ate, hunger 100; warmth 23 still. Drawing water for Kai.

Gave Orla berries and water. Now warming at the fire with all of them.

Felix could not take water. Asking Dax for stone.
Dax refused stone. Thirst 43; drinking from my skin.
Day 5 forenoon, storm. Thirst full, hunger 86. Setting off to quarry stone for our hut.
